verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas offers well-documented official SDKs across multiple layers: the core Engine (npm install playcanvas), @playcanvas/react, @playcanvas/web-components, PCUI, splat-transform CLI, Editor API, and a create-playcanvas scaffolding tool with TypeScript/Vite starters, plus llms.txt docs and an official MCP server for AI agent integration. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of SDK quality beyond vendor docs, and a published OpenAPI/REST spec (probe found no openapi.json, only vendor-listed REST API access).
